subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate options to fill in the blanks.

_________ are used in load cells and proving rings to measure _______ produced.

options.text: Linear Variable Differential Transformer (LVDT); strain by the force
Strain gauges; force by the strain
Capacitive transducers; force by the strain
Piezoelectric transducers; strain by the force

solution:
The correct answer is __Strain gauges**(option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Strain gauges__ are used in load cells and proving rings.
 
• These devices measure strain produced by the force applied.
 
• When force is applied, strain gauges detect the deformation and convert it into electrical signals.
 
• They are highly sensitive and provide accurate readings of force and strain.
 
• Strain gauges are widely used in engineering applications to measure material deformation under stress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Linear Variable Differential Transformer (LVDT):**
 
 
• LVDTs are used for measuring linear displacement.
 
• They work on the principle of mutual inductance.
 
 
 
• **Capacitive transducers:**
 
 
• These transducers measure displacement, pressure, and other quantities by detecting changes in capacitance.
 
• They are not used for measuring strain in load cells or proving rings.
 
 
 
• **Piezoelectric transducers:**
 
 
• Piezoelectric transducers generate electrical charge in response to mechanical stress.
 
• They are commonly used in dynamic measurements such as vibration and acceleration.
